set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Work key: O03.5
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer with institutional operator
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Qualify engineering recovery with the original source services/state inaccessible; physical host/disk-loss qualification remains O03.3 and Q03.1.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O03 (bd-01M4W40KBWB13MJQHFAGJEGYZR)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Back up, then change membership/revoke access/disable a principal; destroy or isolate the disposable source service, catalog and storage namespace, then restore into a new target using separately controlled backup/policy services without source mounts or credentials.
2. Verify old sessions and lost permissions remain unusable, retained release bytes/history remain exact and pending work is safely reacquired.
3. Measure catalog/API recovery and full-byte recovery separately, plus observed data loss; retain environment and raw timing evidence without substituting simulated timestamps.
4. Record physical failure domains explicitly. Same-host container/volume isolation proves source independence only; it cannot certify survival of loss of that computer or disk.
5. Extend and rerun the O03.8 source-isolation oracle with the completed F04.3/O03.2/O03.4 identity and browser-session paths on one candidate build. Old sessions, ended sponsorship and removed bindings cannot regain access; legitimate freshly authenticated users retain only current rights. O03.8 alone cannot close this task.

Verification: Repeatable host-loss rehearsal with network isolation of the source, independent authorization assertions and recovery measurements.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.5/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md

Blocked by:
- O03.4: bd-01M4W5P9KKQ84TJS31E2GM2QKQ
- O03.8: bd-01M4XPDEAPFG0QFQT27TWEKH41

Recovery-first amendment, 14 October 2026; original acceptance retained. O03.6-O03.8 deliver the current-capability path; full integration and institutional gates remain open.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; no institutional or physical-failure qualification from same-host fixtures. Planning closes no implementation work.
